rows.resolution_note: Sentences 2 to 4 of p001 form one description of the decode data (rule F): sentence 2 names the decode database and sentence 3 gives the exact N 35,559 Icelanders with the platform count 4907 aptamers, which together match only the Ferkingstad 2021 row (the Eldjarn 2023 row has 35,892); p002 and p003 give only the deCODE summary-data URL and nothing conflicts.
rows.quote: Genome‐wide association studies (GWASs) were conducted in the past using 4907 aptamers to measure plasma protein levels in 35,559 Icelanders.
